bullets.title: NVDA: Blowout earnings with unprecedented FY28 guidance drives 8-9% rally, adds ~$435B market cap
bullets.body: NVDA reported Q2 revenue of $96B (+106% YoY), net income ~$60B, and 75% gross margins—the highest core-business quarterly profit in company history. FY28 revenue guidance implies +70% growth vs. Street's ~45% estimate; management noted demand running 115-120% above supply capacity, suggesting revenue would be materially higher unconstrained. Raymond James raised PT to $515 (Strong Buy), Evercore to $465 (Outperform), Bernstein to $400; NVDA also reportedly agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B and launched employee-funded PAC (NVPAC).

bullets.title: MRVL: Q2 beat + raised FY27/28 guidance on AI bookings; JPM and Opco both bullish into Investor Day
bullets.body: Marvell reported Q2 revenue $2.74B (+37% YoY) and EPS $0.94, both beating consensus. Q3 guidance of $3.15B (+/-5%) was well above FactSet's $3.04B. Management raised FY27 and FY28 revenue outlooks; AI-related bookings described as 'exceptionally robust' with Custom ASIC accelerating in H2 FY27. Oppenheimer models $24B in CY28 revenue and $11-12 EPS; Google warrants imply $120B cumulative purchases through 2033. Investor Day on 10/6 will detail F28 outlook.

bullets.title: CRM: +22% on strongest NNAOV growth in 4 years; Agentforce and Claudeforce driving AI reacceleration
bullets.body: Salesforce surged ~22% (largest gain since Aug 2020) after Q2 beat and FY27 guidance raise driven by the strongest NNAOV growth in four years. Agentforce is embedding across the platform with milestone-based reporting replacing quarterly ARR disclosure; Claudeforce (Anthropic partnership) launches GA in September and will be bundled into premium tiers. Truist (Buy) raised organic FY27 outlook by $100M; management guides H2 organic revenue stepping up to >8% in Q4.

bullets.title: AFRM: +8.9% AH on 'exceptionally strong' quarter; FY27 GMV guide >$64B ahead of consensus
bullets.body: Affirm surged ~8.9% after hours. Mizuho called the quarter 'exceptionally strong'—FY27 GMV guidance of >$64B exceeded consensus, RLTC grew 39% vs. GMV 36% signaling improving unit economics, and delinquency trends indicate a healthy consumer. Affirm and Shopify also announced expansion of Shop Pay Installments into Australia.

bullets.title: MRVL -7.1% AH vs. AFRM +8.9%, IREN -7.4%: Key after-hours moves post-earnings
bullets.body: Per the after-hours trading summary: AFRM +8.9% ($84.40), MRVL -7.1% ($224.25, -$17.20 despite beat, likely on JPM noting results were 'light of JPM's bars'), and IREN -7.4% ($37.55) post-earnings. S&P 500 futures approximately flat.

bullets.title: ADSK: Citi Neutral; Q2 solid but FY billings raise mostly MaintainX, organic deceleration into 2H
bullets.body: Citi maintains Neutral on ADSK with $269 PT. Q2 revenue $2.05B beat by ~$35M; non-GAAP operating margin 41% (+200bps YoY). However, the ~$70M billings guidance raise is largely attributable to MaintainX acquisition, implying Q4 organic growth of only 11% YoY as transaction-model tailwinds fade. Total RPO grew only 2% YoY. Stock fell 6.2% in after-hours.

bullets.title: NOW: On track for $1.5B AI revenue in 2026; confident in $30-32B 2030 targets
bullets.body: ServiceNow at Deutsche Bank conference reiterated its full-year $1.5B AI revenue target (surpassed $1B annualized in Q2) and 2030 goals of $30-32B revenue at rule-of-60. AI-driven internal efficiency is delivering ~$500M in productivity savings this year enabling flat headcount despite 20%+ revenue growth. Security/risk and new smaller-business product announcements are upcoming growth vectors. Stock +60% from recent lows.

bullets.title: META: $17B child addiction settlement + projected $10B/year Anthropic AI spend; stock -0.9%
bullets.body: Meta settled state AG claims over youth harm for up to $17B, altering teen app access. Separately, NYT reports Meta could spend up to $10B/year on Anthropic AI tools (confirmed Meta is among Anthropic's largest customers). Meta declined 0.9% on the day despite advertising segment strength. META also pursuing enterprise AI expansion with 90-day cancellation flexibility on external compute deals.

bullets.title: FOXA: -3.4% on News Corp recombination speculation from Nevada probate court documents
bullets.body: Fox Corp fell 3.4% after Reuters reported court documents from Nevada probate proceedings suggest the Murdoch family may revisit combining Fox Corp and News Corp. Lachlan Murdoch's attorney referenced the potential combination as 'something that still could happen in the future.' A prior merger attempt was withdrawn in 2022-23.

bullets.title: TTD: +3% on Kokai Zuma AI platform launch with agentic advertising capabilities
bullets.body: The Trade Desk gained 3% after introducing Kokai Zuma, a new agentic AI platform with capabilities for advertising planning, buying, and measurement. The advertising segment was the best-performing media sub-sector on the day (+1%).

bullets.title: APP: -38% post-earnings; digital ad thesis questioned but some see buy opportunity
bullets.body: AppLovin fell 38% after earnings. Multiple accounts are mapping the digital ad supply chain (vs. GOOGL, TTD, OMC) to assess whether this is a broken thesis or a buying opportunity. No clear consensus on the call.

bullets.title: NVDA acquires Hugging Face for ~$12.9B; AWS commits to 2M additional Nvidia GPUs
bullets.body: NVDA reportedly agreed to acquire open-source AI platform Hugging Face for ~$12.9B, positioning the company at the center of the open-source AI ecosystem. Separately, AWS is purchasing multiple million additional Nvidia GPUs for 2027-2028 deployment, even while ramping its own Trainium chips. Anthropic also signed a $45B deal with Nscale for 460MW of compute capacity.

bullets.title: FSLR: BMO upgrades to Outperform, PT $263 from $237 on post-S232 sell-off opportunity
bullets.body: BMO Capital Markets upgraded First Solar to Outperform and raised its PT to $263 from $237, arguing the post-Section 232 tariff sell-off is overdone. BMO sees a favorable window for FY29+ bookings and views Tesla competitive risks as more than priced in. Trump EO banning foreign equipment from US energy grid was also seen as broadly positive for domestic solar producers.

bullets.title: CMCSA: -2.9% as Universal Studios Japan plans ¥300B ($1.9B) Osaka park expansion through 2030
bullets.body: Comcast fell 2.9% after Nikkei reported Universal Studios Japan plans to invest up to ¥300B (~$1.9B) through 2030 for a major Osaka theme park expansion. While long-term revenue accretive, the capex scale and timing may have weighed on near-term sentiment.

bullets.title: MGM/WYNN: Vegas Strip July GGR +4% YoY but UBS estimates MGM Q3 GGR only +1% vs Street +4%
bullets.body: Las Vegas Strip July gaming revenue ex-baccarat was +4% YoY to $660M, accelerating from June's +2%. However, UBS estimates MGM Vegas GGR will grow only +1% YoY in Q3 vs. the Street's +4% consensus, partly due to MGM's comp accounting change creating a 1.5pt RevPAR headwind. Wynn is seen as most impacted by July's unusually low baccarat hold of 12.4% (vs. 13% average).

bullets.title: DKNG: NY OSB weekly GGR -11% YoY but 3QTD tracking +26% YoY
bullets.body: New York online sports betting GGR was -11% YoY for the week ending 8/23 but 3Q26 year-to-date is tracking +26% YoY with hold up 170bps. DraftKings had weekly GGR -31% but 3QTD +23% YoY (35% handle share); FanDuel ran -4% weekly but +22% 3QTD. Fanatics continues rapid growth with 3QTD GGR +120% YoY.

bullets.title: MU/SNDK: SK Hynix CEO says memory shortage to persist through 2030; HBM/DRAM/NAND thesis intact
bullets.body: SK Hynix CEO stated the memory shortage is expected to continue through 2030, a bullish read-through for Micron and SanDisk. Separately, Kioxia and SanDisk committed $31B to the Kitakami facility. Contrarian analyst argues MU and SNDK are not at cycle peak because HBM, DRAM, and NAND are fundamentally distinct business units that should be evaluated separately.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $353M UK Play Store settlement; Pixel Watch legal proceedings ongoing
bullets.body: Google agreed to pay £260M ($353M) to settle a UK class-action brought by app developers alleging abuse of Play Store market dominance through excessive commissions. Closing arguments are underway in Johnson v. Google Pixel Watch case.

bullets.title: ADBE: Stagwell partnership expansion + new AI Assisted Editor in Photoshop
bullets.body: Adobe expanded its strategic partnership with Stagwell for enterprise demand generation and value realization services across priority industries. Adobe also launched an 'AI Assisted Editor' interface in Photoshop, consolidating generative AI features into a simplified toolbar. Separately, Claude reportedly took profits on ADBE in an AI-managed portfolio.

bullets.title: ORCL: Credit default risk hits record high, surpassing 2008 levels per Bloomberg
bullets.body: Oracle's credit default swap spreads hit a record level, exceeding even 2008 financial crisis peaks according to Bloomberg data. No analyst commentary on the specific driver was included in this window.
